# Light Language – lightlanguage.justbe.works

Site for Light Language Grid Creator (JustBe.Works): coloured light and sacred geometry on Grids, a short PDF from the Beginning teaching, and the app on iPhone, iPad, Apple Vision Pro, and Mac.

Light Language here follows the Starr Fuentes / Mayan-Aztec lineage: coloured light and sacred geometry to make clear messages. With a teacher: a good teacher has an aura that makes understanding easier; it is transferred from his field, not grasped with thought. The app is colour, shape, Grid, export.

Regenerate (from this `website` folder): `python3 scripts/generate_manual_summaries.py` (once: `pip3 install fpdf2`)
